sentences.text: "3. Earlier the instant petition along with CWP-11445-2008 and other connected CWPs were disposed of by this Court on 27.10.2016.
The said decision became challenged before the Hon'ble Apex Court by filings of SLPs.
The Hon'ble Apex Court through a decision made on 13.11.2021, on the said SLPs, set aside the impugned order, and, remitted the instant writ petition to this Court for deciding it afresh.
Thereafter, when the instant petition came up for hearing on 27.9.2022, it was adjourned sine die to await the decision of SLP (C) No. 003881-2020.
The operative part of the decision on the said SLP is extracted hereinafter.
"In such view of the matter, the appeal is allowed.

Accordingly, the impugned order stands set aside and the matter is remitted to the High Court to be decided on the issues other than the one covering the field in Indore Development Authority (supra)""
2.

The learned Senior counsel appearing for the review application as well as the learned State counsel, both are in alignment to the effect that the said premise is prima facie misfounded, thus for lack of a proper communication becoming purveyed to this Court by the learned counsels then appearing on behalf of the contesting litigants before this Court.

The said miscommunication, thus led this Court to, in paragraph 3 (supra), conclude that there is a necessity cast on this Court to make a re- 2 of 3 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:087545-DB RA-CW-188-2024 (O&M) (CWP-3943-2014),
WITH RA-CW-284-2024 (O&M) IN CWP-3943-2014 -3- adjudication, upon the subject writ petition, thus on the ground that the same becomes remitted to this Court by an order of remand made by the Apex Court, whereas, as stated (supra), there was no order of remand for a fresh adjudication being made upon the subject writ petition by this Court.

RA-CW-284-2024 1. Since the relief claimed in the instant review application is similar to the one as asked in RA-CW-188-2024, which has been allowed, as such the instant review application is also allowed in the same terms.
2. Pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, stand(s), disposed of.
3. A photocopy of this order be placed on the file of other connected review application.
